have h_enc_inj : Function.Injective enc := by
    intro x₁ x₂ henc
    have hq : q x₁ = q x₂ := by
      simpa only [enc] using congrArg Prod.fst henc
    have hk : idx x₁ = idx x₂ := by
      simpa only [enc] using congrArg Prod.snd henc
    have hx₁ :
        qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
          (y := q x₁) (idx x₁) = x₁ := by
      apply (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
        (x := x₁) (y := q x₁)).mp
      rfl
    have hx₂ :
        qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
          (y := q x₁) (idx x₂) = x₂ := by
      apply (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
        (x := x₂) (y := q x₁)).mp
      exact hq
    rw [←hx₁, ←hx₂, hk]

have h_enc_inj : Function.Injective enc := by
    intro x₁ x₂ henc
    have hq : q x₁ = q x₂ := by
      simpa only [enc] using congrArg Prod.fst henc
    have hk : idx x₁ = idx x₂ := by
      simpa only [enc] using congrArg Prod.snd henc
    have hx₁ :
        qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
          (y := q x₁) (idx x₁) = x₁ := by
      apply (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
        (x := x₁) (y := q x₁)).mp
      rfl
    have hx₂ :
        qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
          (y := q x₁) (idx x₂) = x₂ := by
      apply (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
        (x := x₂) (y := q x₁)).mp
      exact hq
    rw [←hx₁, ←hx₂, hk]

      Code.distFromCode (u := f) (C := C_i) ≤ (hammingDist f g : ℕ∞) := by
    unfold Code.distFromCode
    apply sInf_le
    use (g : _)
    exact ⟨g.property, le_rfl⟩

left✝ : g ∈ Set.univ
hg_min : (fun g => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f ↑g).ncard) g = sInf S

  fun x => iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
idx : ↥(sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩) → Fin (2 ^ steps) :=
  fun x => pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩ steps h_i_add_steps x
enc : ↥(sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩) → ↥(sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨↑i + steps, ⋯⟩) × Fin (2 ^ steps) :=
  fun x => (q x, idx x)
h_enc_inj : Function.Injective enc
D : Finset ↥(sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨↑⟨↑i, ⋯⟩, ⋯⟩) := {x | f x ≠ sorry}
FW : Finset ↥(sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨↑i + steps, ⋯⟩) := sorry
T : Finset (↥(sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨↑i + steps, ⋯⟩) × Fin (2 ^ steps)) := FW ×ˢ univ
h_maps : Set.MapsTo enc ↑D ↑T
h_card : #D ≤ #T
h_hamming_le : Δ₀(f, ↑g) ≤ 2 ^ steps * (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f ↑g).ncard
h_selected_lt :
  2 * (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f ↑g).ncard < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i + steps, ⋯⟩
h_base : 2 * (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f ↑g).ncard ≤ BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i + steps, ⋯⟩ - 1
h_distance_scale : BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩ = (BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i + steps, ⋯⟩ - 1) * 2 ^ steps + 1

h_dist_le : Δ₀(f, ↑C_i) ≤ ↑Δ₀(f, ↑g)
⊢ hammingClose 𝔽q β ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩ f
